epic_text:
Epic: Multi-Channel Notification System
As a user, I want to receive notifications for important events so that I stay informed.

AC1: In-app notification center with read/unread status
AC2: Email notifications for critical events (password reset, security alerts)
AC3: Push notifications for mobile (iOS/Android)
AC4: Notification preferences: user can enable/disable per event type
AC5: Batch mode: daily digest email at 9am local time
AC6: Notification history retained for 90 days
prd_text: Multi-channel notification system supporting in-app, email (SendGrid), and push (Firebase). Users configure preferences per event type. Batch digest mode aggregates non-critical notifications.
architecture_text: Event-driven: Kafka → Notification Service → Channel Adapters. Redis for notification queue. PostgreSQL for user preferences and history. Template engine for message formatting.
ux_text: Notification bell icon with badge count. Dropdown shows recent 20 notifications. Settings page with toggle switches per event type per channel.

epic_text:
Epic: Search Autocomplete
As a user, I want search suggestions as I type so that I can find products faster.

AC1: Suggestions appear after 2 characters typed
AC2: Max 10 suggestions displayed
AC3: Suggestions ranked by popularity (last 30 days)
AC4: Recent searches shown when input is empty
AC5: Keyboard navigation (arrow keys + enter)
AC6: Debounce: 300ms delay before API call
prd_text: Search autocomplete for e-commerce product catalog. Must handle 50k+ products. Suggestions ranked by purchase frequency. Cache popular queries in Redis.
architecture_text: Frontend: React with debounced input. Backend: FastAPI endpoint. Elasticsearch for full-text search with completion suggester. Redis cache for top 1000 queries.

epic_text:
Epic: Data Export & Reporting
As a manager, I want to export reports so that I can analyze data offline.

AC1: Export to CSV, Excel, PDF formats
AC2: Custom date range selection
AC3: Column selection (choose which fields to export)\AC4: Large dataset: streaming export for 100k+ rows
AC5: Async generation with email notification when ready
AC6: Export history with download links (7-day expiry)
prd_text: Data export service supporting multiple formats. Must handle large datasets without memory issues. Async processing for exports > 10k rows.
architecture_text: FastAPI endpoint triggers Celery task. Pandas for CSV/Excel, WeasyPrint for PDF. S3 for file storage. Redis for task status. SSE for real-time progress.
